info.title: Caspian College CRM API
info.description: Trusted server integration. Dedicated Bearer tokens required. See crm-api.md for daily reminder slots, idempotency and Railway Free cold starts.

post.summary: Create and dispatch a task from the CRM
post.description: Write-token only. Same workflow as the task form. source+event_id is shared with reminder events. Same normalized payload returns 200; changed payload returns 409. Total body <=16 KiB. Files and arbitrary workflow fields are rejected.

201.description: Task dispatched with history, notifications and receipt atomically.

Location.description: Relative GET URL of the created task

200.description: Idempotent retry: same task ID, current Task state, meta.duplicate=true.

Location.description: Relative GET URL of the created task

post.summary: CRM event creates platform deadline notifications

get.summary: Existing authoritative platform and department metrics

due_at.description: Current deadline snapshot; offset or Z required
Deadline with Z or explicit UTC offset, converted to UTC. Past deadlines follow existing form rules.

author_id.description: Active employee or department head. Sender department is inferred; admin is not eligible.

recipient_department_id.description: Active department different from the author department.

title.description: Trimmed before validation; blank, invalid Unicode and NUL rejected.

description.description: Trimmed; blank, invalid Unicode and NUL rejected. Total JSON body <=16 KiB.
